reponse: A service credit, not a refund, was approved for Loomly: the November payout fees on the affected payouts only (1,212 payouts, ≈ $3,940), applied on Loomly's December invoice, with no cash refunds and nothing paid to individual sellers [2]. Carla confirmed the same by email, to be detailed on Friday's call [3], and a Jira ticket tracks adding the credit line to the December invoice [4]. Policy allows credits on the next invoice, while cash refunds need CEO approval and go only to the contracting customer, never its sellers [5]. One ticket asks for a full refund of all November fees and a wire, claiming management approval, which contradicts that [1].
